corrections.original: conclusion: "The strict criterion is only satisfiable with identical preprocessing"
corrections.corrected: On the two sampled frames, the strict criterion failed under every tested preprocessing difference, including between two CPU-only references that differ only in YUV->RGB matrix. This demonstrates sensitivity on those frames; it does not establish that identical preprocessing is universally required, nor that a closer pipeline could never pass.
corrections.reason: Two frames and four preprocessing variants cannot support a universal claim.

corrections.original: unmatched_confidence_profile: "... at or near the 0.25 decision threshold"
corrections.corrected: Unmatched supersample pre-tracker objects have confidences up to 0.494, about twice the 0.25 threshold. Many lie between 0.25 and 0.34, but the discrepancies are not all threshold-edge effects and must not be dismissed as such.
